title: Sum of Mutated Array Closest to Target
summary: Given an integer array and a target, find the integer value to replace all larger elements with, such that the new sum of the array is as close as possible to the target.
statement: Given an integer array and a target, find the integer value to replace all larger elements with, such that the new sum of the array is as close as possible to the target. In case of a tie, choose the smallest value. The result does not have to be in the original array.
constraints: Replace values greater than the chosen nonnegative cap by the cap.
Minimize distance from target; ties choose the smaller cap.
hints: The capped sum is nondecreasing in the cap.
Binary-search the first cap whose sum reaches or exceeds target.
Compare that cap with the preceding cap using distance then cap value.
Only the two caps around the crossing can minimize absolute distance.
editorial: Only the two caps around the crossing can minimize absolute distance.

tests.explanation: Cap three gives sum nine, closer than cap four giving eleven.
No cap below the maximum improves the unchanged sum, so return five.
